preservedResponsibilities: Original FD FileHandle_Impl page cache, logical cursor/size, dirty flush and sequential/positional IO with checked ssize_t/off_t bounds are ported over actual pinned Emscripten FS POSIX primitives. Source FD constructor writeable assumption, deferred genuine BADF and close-after-flush-failure are preserved. Header enum order and errno translation preserve ENXIO-to-IO and pinned wasm32 libc aliases. Source page size65536 is compiler profile, JS buffers GC-managed, non-pthread mutex stubs unchanged. Actual descriptor tests port source setPos/getPos/read/write/isEndOfFile/setSize assertions; File URL entry points, KIND_MEM/line/map, all backend/SvFileStream/TempFile/model/UI and native pthread/ABI/physical allocator/unsafe JS numeric offset domains remain unported or unqualified. No fake FS/descriptor/provider or successful full-format claim.

Explicitly user-approved original setAllowedPaths/isForbidden and pre-open ACCES hook are ported with source read/write/execute lists, literal prefix matching, empty-read bypass, parent/realpath recursion, partial setup and abort environment order. Native openFilePath uses actual libc/MEMFS flags, open/stat/optional F_SETLK/cleanup and original handle state. Full active Forbidden::forbidden QA assertions and real create/truncate/exclusive/read-only/permissions/symlink/abort integration are exercised. Original openFile/osl_openFile validate URL/output pointers, use actual PATH_MAX and delegate to the existing native openFilePath/security/flags/mode owner. Actual native descriptor create/write/close/reopen/read, Unicode URL conversion, live output retention, bounds, denied creation and source slash removal are tested; browser/DOM-free Worker exercise real public URL IO. Other path/File C++ APIs, native length_error/OOM/invalid lifetime and full SvFileStream/TempFile/package/storage/model/filter/UI remain unfinished or unqualified.

Original public osl_copyFile/osl_removeFile and consumed File wrapper are now ported: URL conversion and already approved read/create/write gates, source lstat/destination stat, wasm32 source size cast, .osl-tmp backup and ignored cleanup/rollback errors, source link-content copying and regular-file 0x7fff buffered copy with original errno/ENOSPC behavior. Exact native destination open omits TRUNC/EXCL. Genuine SDK FS errors publish native errno; no synthetic syscall provider, host filesystem mount, or metadata-preserving move branch is introduced. Active original File copy/remove QA assertions and actual descriptor/permissions/link/backup regression tests are present. Native EINTR, zero-progress write assertion, source races/OOM and full SvFileStream/TempFile/package/storage/model/filter/UI acceptance remain unqualified or unfinished.
